open_points.subject: personal-data disclosure boundary for direct service access
open_points.text: “Personal data — values of class `personal_data` reach an agent only as digest and class; the owner alone reads them.” contradicts “An agent's own access to a service … is granted by that service and the owner outside the kernel; the kernel neither gives nor checks it, and its personal-data promise (K-14) covers what the kernel itself returns.”
open_points.question: Does the agent-never-receives-personal-data guarantee apply only to values returned through the kernel surface, or also to an agent's direct access to a microservice?
options: Scope the guarantee to the kernel surface only
Require direct service access to preserve digest-and-class disclosure
Prohibit agents from directly accessing service-held personal data
open_points.default_guess: Scope the guarantee to values returned through the kernel surface only.
